highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 moves to Skia m153, adding Graphite GPU bindings and safer native object lifetimes.
highlights_body: The release also adds asynchronous pixel readback, restores Vulkan Silk.NET package production, and improves native debugging symbols. Linux font fallback can select a different face; use an explicit or bundled typeface when exact selection matters.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before its previous FcFontSort fallback. Applications that rely on the exact fontconfig fallback face may see different glyphs or text metrics; specify the family and style explicitly or bundle the typeface when selection must be deterministic.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer through the m151 stability and bug-fix syncs to m152 and m153, bringing current upstream rendering behavior to the release line.
Adds managed bindings for Skia's Graphite backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
SKImage and SKSurface gain backend-neutral RequestReadPixels support for reading pixels asynchronously.
Fixes use-after-free failures when iterating an SKRegion or creating SKPixmap subsets and derived pixmaps, and fixes a raster-image failure-path allocation leak.

bullets.lead: Runtime-effect buffers and managed allocations improved
bullets.detail: Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms now disposes its previous buffer, while SKData saving, encoded-text retrieval, tag formatting, and uniform lookup avoid unnecessary allocations.

bullets.lead: Native symbols and package support strengthened
bullets.detail: Apple native symbol packages are produced during packing, the Vulkan Silk.NET package is restored, and Nano Server gains FreeType-based font support.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Improved Windows native-build setup by initializing the MSVC environment once
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the m152 engine update, Graphite GPU backend bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, native lifetime fixes, and improved platform package support.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added the m152 servicing sync, Apple native symbol packages, restored Vulkan Silk.NET packaging, and lifetime and allocation fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp improves Font.Shape by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy, fixes SKStreamAsset lifetime handling when creating blobs, and reduces tag-formatting allocations.
